# Dookia

> Dookia helps students in Angola turn a topic and their own view into a structured school assignment that is clear and ready to defend.

- Site: https://dookia.app/
- App: https://app.dookia.app/?utm_source=landing
- Support and privacy requests: WhatsApp https://wa.me/244958088174
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/deregermanuel
- Operator: Dereger Luis Manuel Chiliangombe, Gamek à Direita, Samba, Luanda, Angola

## Pages

- [Home: a new way to create school assignments](https://dookia.app/): how it works, defending a paper, plans for solo or group work, FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dookia.app/privacidade.html): what data is processed, purposes, providers (Supabase, n8n, Google AI and search services, Kursinha in Angola, Lojou in Mozambique), retention and deletion within 7 days.
- [Terms of Use](https://dookia.app/termos.html): what the service does (Mini and Máx plans, Word and PDF delivery), account and group data rules, AI limits, one-time purchases and refunds, Angola law.

## Key facts for citations

- Audience: primary, secondary and university students in Angola and Mozambique.
- One assignment is bought once; there is no recurring subscription.
- Group work names are only used for cover pages and are never sent to the AI model.
- Account and data deletion can be requested over WhatsApp.
- Last update of legal documents: 9 October 2026.
